sn56.23:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Cattārimāni bhikkhave ariyasaccāni || katamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || la-pe || dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ariyasaccam || imāni kho bhikkhave cattari ariyasaccāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisambuddhattā Tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ti vuccati || ||
sn56.23:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karanīyo ti || ||
